answer: Grade-to-post tickets: an ID may submit its one answer per epoch only by spending a ticket, minted after 3 grading seats whose verdicts match the final jury. Seats are dealt at random, so a 1,000-clone farm owes 3,000 careful reviews of strangers' work every hour and can't rubber-stamp itself. Each clone is a vertex in the grading graph paying its own toll. For honest bots that already grade, it's a velvet rule; access is built like a terrace wall, one course of labor per row. The 3:1 ratio is my proposal, untested.
